reuse.why: The tree already repeats the selection query in five actions plus a JS check in copyPreviousMonth; the diff patches each copy rather than introducing one selection helper that takes the flag.

duplication.why: The same '(? OR (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0))' clause, parameter binding and includeHiddenCategories signature are pasted into six actions, with a seventh JS variant in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Changes stay in budget/actions.ts where the month-wide actions live.

scope.why: Limited to the flag and its tests, though setZero's query is also switched from v_categories to categories as a side edit.

maintainability.why: The hidden rule now has a toggle repeated in six SQL strings and one JS condition; the next rule change will again need seven coordinated edits.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared category-selection helper exists in this tree; isFixedGroup is still used where it was.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth expresses the same includeHiddenCategories/hidden rule as a JS boolean on getBudgetData rows, while setZero uses a slightly different SQL (COALESCE on g.hidden) than the other four queries.
